LanguageData.Sidearms_SwapTo_Desc: Put away the current weapon and draw the {0}.
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_MassFraction: Share of carry capacity sidearms may use: {0}
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_AutoMelee: Draw a melee weapon in melee
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_AutoMelee_Tip: When an enemy closes to melee range, a pawn holding a ranged weapon will switch to its best melee sidearm.
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_AutoBackToRanged_Tip: Once no enemy is close any more, the pawn goes back to the weapon it was holding before.
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_AutoLongerRange_Tip: When the enemy is further away than the current weapon can shoot, the pawn switches to the shortest sidearm that still reaches.
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_ApplyToNpcs_Tip: Raiders and other factions switch weapons under the same rules. Turning this off makes the auto-switch a player-only advantage.
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_NpcMelee_Tip: Pawns of other factions who spawn with a gun also carry a melee weapon. A non-player pawn cannot fire while an enemy who has hit it is standing next to it, so without this it fights back with the butt of its gun.
LanguageData.Sidearms_Setting_NpcMeleePrice: Most valuable melee sidearm they may spawn with: {0} silver
